main_body: shrine building with teal tiled roof and red/white front walls
top_band: teal sloped roof surface from row 4 to row 42 (with gold katsuogi on top from rows 0-3)
evidence: The structure clearly shows a large foreshortened top/sloped roof surface (rows 4-42) in teal with ridge beam and katsuogi at the top, a bright red lintel/beam edge at rows 43-45, an eave shadow at row 46, and recessed white walls and dark lattice doors below (rows 47-73) resting on a stone base (rows 74-78).

style.evidence: The candidate uses a 5-step teal ramp on the roof, 4-5 steps on the red woodwork, gold ornaments, and stone base, and dark material-tinted outlines (dark brown/red on wood, deep teal/slate on roof). However, compared to the Beodeul reference buildings which have varied individual tile highlights and rich plaster/stonework grain, the candidate's roof consists of repetitive vertical stripes and the white walls have only very subtle low-contrast speckle, reading slightly cleaner and more mechanical than the reference.
